question: Dhyan Chand was a legendary Player of which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhyan Chand** was a legendary **Player of Hockey.**
 
• He was **born **on **29 August 1905** in **Allahabad**, United Provinces of Agra and Oudh, British India( today's Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh).
 
• He was a prominent Indian field hockey player who is considered one of the greatest players of all time**.**
 
• He was **known **as **The Wizard** or **The Magician of hockey**
 
• He was a part of the three-time **Olympic gold medalist** Indian Hockey Team in the **1928**, **1932**, and **1936 Olympics**.
 
• He received the **Padma Bhushan Award**, India's third-highest civilian honor, in **1956 **for his contributions to Indian hockey.
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** is named after him to honor his contribution to Indian sports by the Government Of India (GOI).
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement in Sports and Games** is a lifetime achievement sporting honor named after him.
